name: Tracking Alpha
summary: Pre-launch tool for discovering and following US cash merger-arbitrage deals, with sourced updates, deadlines and scenario calculations. Waitlist open.

name: Stock Radar
summary: Stock Radar is an educational iOS and Android app for reviewing directional signals on US-listed stocks and ETFs, with risk context, targets and stops when available, a watchlist, and recorded outcomes. iOS is available in the US; Android availability depends on Google Play country. It is not personalized financial advice.
